subject.title: fix(nextcloud-talk): reject unsupported channel add URL schemes

question: Should non-interactive Nextcloud Talk setup reject previously accepted bare-host and non-HTTP(S) URL inputs to match the guided setup validator?
rationale: The patch is narrow and proved, but it deliberately changes failure behavior for existing automation that supplied values which were accepted and written before.

options.title: Approve parity after refresh
options.body: Require a rebase onto current `main` and refreshed exact-head proof, then accept the shared guided/non-interactive HTTP(S) validation contract.

options.title: Preserve permissive CLI input
options.body: Keep the current non-interactive acceptance behavior if maintainers intentionally support another URL form and document or implement that explicit contract.

recommendation.title: Approve parity after refresh
recommendation.body: Require a rebase onto current `main` and refreshed exact-head proof, then accept the shared guided/non-interactive HTTP(S) validation contract.
